_README: This is the GENESIS config every node must agree on. 'founders' is the list of testnet founding addresses (each has run {op:'seal_founder'}); 'relay' is the default relay a downloaded node dials. The two entries are the SEALED testnet founder nodes: M_EDB46A05… = the Hetzner testnet box (Nuremberg), M_21F72398… = the desktop node (Dunham). A wrong list means every friend's node shows members:0 and warns possible-fork. Entries must match M_ + 32 uppercase hex chars (the node refuses to start otherwise). This file is NOT secret (no private keys) and ships inside the download; it is NOT served by the relay, so a compromised relay cannot swap the founder set.
